name: Zomato-Recommendation-system
description: This is a Streamlit-based web app that recommends Restaurants based on user preferences.

paragraphs: Find your perfect dining spot in the India region! The Zomato Restaurant Recommendation System is an interactive web application that helps users discover the best restaurants tailored to their specific tastes. Whether you are craving North Indian, South Indian, Chinese, or any other cuisine, this system provides personalized dining recommendations.
In addition to the recommendation web app, this repository includes a comprehensive Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) of the Zomato dataset.
features: Search by Name: Enter a specific restaurant name (e.g., Subway) to find similar recommendations.
Cuisine Preferences: Filter recommendations by your preferred cuisines.
Rating Filter: Set a minimum rating threshold (from 0.00 to 5.00) to ensure high-quality dining experiences.
Location Filtering: Select specific cities within India (e.g., New Delhi).
Adjustable Results: Choose the exact number of restaurant recommendations you want to see.
